questions.question: Susan Benade set a database record (14/15 season, T20) with a value of 28. Which record is it?
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Fastest 50 (by balls)', held by Susan Benade.

questions.question: Which player is the only one to ever score 150 runs and take 5 wickets in a single match?
questions.explanation: Marizanne Kapp is the only player in the database to combine a 150-run score with a 5-wicket haul in the same innings, doing so against Kei on 16 January 2011 (163 runs, 6 for 6).

questions.question: How many wickets separate the all-time #1 (Chloé Tryon) and #2 (Rasika Maharaj) wicket-takers (combined T20 + List A) in the 09/10 season?
questions.explanation: Chloé Tryon: 24 — Rasika Maharaj: 18 — a gap of 6.

questions.question: At which ground did Tuskers record their 'Highest Total' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at City Oval — highest total of 137, against Rhinos on 2015/03/15.
